From 91478b772fb525da8a6541231e6e0eb016f941c3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sakari Ailus <sakari.ailus@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Dec 2023 12:12:13 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] media: ccs: Select V4L2_CCI_I2C

Select V4L2_CCI_I2C Kconfig option which the CCS driver now depends on.

Fixes: 529322112a3b ("media: ccs: Use V4L2 CCI for accessing sensor registers")
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/oe-kbuild-all/202312060941.CYiHppAp-lkp@intel.com/
Signed-off-by: Sakari Ailus <sakari.ailus@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil-cisco@xs4all.nl>

diff --git a/drivers/media/i2c/ccs/Kconfig b/drivers/media/i2c/ccs/Kconfig
index b55c93a2e204..710a729ae42d 100644
--- a/drivers/media/i2c/ccs/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/media/i2c/ccs/Kconfig
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 config VIDEO_CCS
 	tristate "MIPI CCS/SMIA++/SMIA sensor support"
 	depends on HAVE_CLK
+	select V4L2_CCI_I2C
 	select VIDEO_CCS_PLL
 	help
 	  This is a generic driver for MIPI CCS, SMIA++ and SMIA compliant
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/media/i2c/ccs/Kconfig`**
   - A new line was added to select the `V4L2_CCI_I2C` Kconfig option. This indicates that the CCS driver now has a dependency on this option.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Kconfig` file establishes a dependency for the CCS driver on the `V4L2_CCI_I2C` option, which is necessary for the driver to function correctly. This change addresses a bug related to the CCS driver that was reported by the kernel test robot, ensuring that the driver can properly access sensor registers using the V4L2 CCI framework.

media: ccs: Select V4L2_CCI_I2C

Here is the root cause:
The CCS driver did not have the necessary dependency on the `V4L2_CCI_I2C` Kconfig option, which is required for proper access to sensor registers using the V4L2 CCI framework. This oversight led to functionality issues when the driver attempted to operate without the required configuration.

The CCS driver did not declare a dependency on the `V4L2_CCI_I2C` Kconfig option, which is essential for accessing sensor registers through the V4L2 CCI framework. Without this dependency, the driver may attempt to operate without the necessary configuration, leading to functionality issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+select V4L2_CCI_I2C
```
Reason:
By adding `select V4L2_CCI_I2C`, the patch ensures that the CCS driver will automatically enable the required Kconfig option, thereby providing the necessary support for accessing sensor registers correctly and preventing the functionality issues that arose from the previous oversight.
